transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo recertification next week, and two available training blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. I need to publish the final schedule after we sort this out. Let's start with what we know and figure out how to slot these cohorts. Who's got information I should be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I checked the training database this morning — the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, and he's available during the Monday 0800-1200 block. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, but I can confirm his authorization is current.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, I need to flag a conflict. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this is the first time it's coming up.
